question: Which country will soon allow Indian travelers to use UPI for transactions, according to the agreement between NPCI International Payments Ltd and NTT DATA Japan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Japan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Indian travelers will soon be able to use **UPI** for transactions in **Japan**, following an agreement between NPCI International Payments Ltd (NIPL) and NTT DATA Japan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Under the new MoU, UPI payments will be integrated into merchant outlets across Japan, enabling Indian tourists to use UPI for payments in INR.
 
• The agreement eliminates the need for currency conversion and foreign cards, making it easier for Indian travelers.
 
• NTT DATA, which operates CAFIS (Japan’s largest card transaction network), will help facilitate this integration.
 
• India’s UPI expansion will help in improving global payment systems, enhancing convenience and supporting India’s fintech leadership.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **UPI Global Expansion**__: UPI is already accepted in countries like Bhutan, France, Mauritius, Nepal, Singapore, Sri Lanka, and UAE.
 
• __**UPI's Role in Digital Diplomacy**__: This move supports India’s fintech diplomacy and promotes India’s soft power globally.
 
• __**Other Countries**__: UPI integration is also planned in Qatar, Oman, and the UK, though these are still in the rollout phase.
 
• __**NIPL**__: NPCI International Payments Ltd (NIPL) is working to expand UPI acceptance internationally.
